title: remind_applicant returns #(0, 1) (follow-up sent) for an email not in the awaiting pool
detail: Any email not present in the pool (or an already-reminded, non-due row) yields sent_reminded False, so the toast reports a follow-up was sent for an applicant that doesn't exist or wasn't touched.
recommended_fix: Return #(0, 0) when the email is absent and when the row is already fully followed up; only #(0, 1) when a follow-up actually flipped.

title: Doc comment promises #(0, 0) outcome that the code can never produce
evidence:
/// stage 1, followed-up). Mirrors the real per-applicant remind semantics
/// (`remind_applicant_toast_copy`: 1,0 / 0,1 / 0,0). The row's stage state
detail: sent_reminded is a Bool, so only #(1, 0) and #(0, 1) are reachable; the documented 0,0 case is dead, meaning the comment misdescribes the function.
recommended_fix: Either implement the 0,0 branch (unknown email / already followed-up) or correct the doc comment.

title: awaiting/2 doc says it falls back to the seed, but the fallback is an empty list
detail: Comment claims 'fallback to the seed when the key is absent'; the code returns []. Either behaviour or comment is wrong for empty_store callers.
recommended_fix: Fall back to dict.get(seed_awaiting(), vacancy_id) on a miss, or fix the comment to say unknown keys yield an empty pool.

title: Test defines result_map_custom, a hand-rolled re-implementation of result.map
detail: gleam/result.map does exactly this; a bespoke duplicate helper in a test file is dead-weight and invites drift.
recommended_fix: Import gleam/result and use result.map at the call site; delete result_map_custom.

title: Wordmark test asserts substring href="/" which any landing link in the page satisfies
evidence:
let demo = demo_model()
  element.to_string(client.view(demo))
  |> string.contains("href=\"/\"")
  |> should.be_true
detail: contains("href=\"/\"") matches any landing link rendered anywhere in the full view, not specifically the header wordmark; the test passes even if view_wordmark still points at /dashboard while another link to / exists.
recommended_fix: Assert on the wordmark element itself (e.g. the data-testid="header-wordmark" node's href) rather than a whole-page substring.
